integrator_mirror.root_cause: The mirror surface reads .noos-runtime/integrator/noos-integrator-state-v1.json, which is gitignored and local-only. On a fresh GitHub Actions checkout it is structurally absent, so the surface returns missing_repo_state and reports false regardless of the real mirror state. Reproduced independently in a clean worktree, which showed the same false red until the real runtime state was made visible.
integrator_mirror.action_taken: None on the mirror itself - it was already clean. The false red is an environment artifact, recorded here rather than silenced.
integrator_mirror.not_changed_and_why: Making the surface NOT_OBSERVED in CI would flip scripts/verify_noos_icl_p2_v1.py (ICL-P2-01) from FAIL to PASS in CI. That verifier is L5 frozen, so changing its verdict indirectly is a founder gate, not a machine repair. Flagged, not applied.

autorun_critique.root_cause: scripts/autorun_status_v1.py resolved its GitHub token only via 'git credential fill'. GitHub Actions installs an http.extraheader instead of a credential-helper entry, so in CI the call returned no password, github_latest_run returned ok:false, and probe_github_schedule degraded every schedule-probed witness to BLOCKED_WITH_REASON/no_github_runs. That is the origin of the no_github_runs findings, and it made the autorun witness exit 1, which then failed the witness, which then reddened the stack rollup.
autorun_critique.repair: github_token() now prefers GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN and falls back to the credential helper. All five witness workflows already export GH_TOKEN with actions: read.
autorun_critique.note: The pair was produced with the credential helper disabled, which reproduces the CI condition. Full confirmation requires the fix on main and one witness rerun.

liveness_registry.provenance_law_respected: loop_factory_cycles writes were skipped by the repair itself (gated_by_default_provenance_law) so no repair row masks an organic stall.
liveness_registry.remaining: role_circle is not machine-repairable here. It is a lane registration left by the runway-supervision builder lane (draft PR #90) that went silent on 2026-07-19. Upserting its heartbeat would mask an organic stall; deregistration belongs to that lane.

gha_health_witness.actual_defect: Its observations, not its runs. The same no_github_runs blindness above made it report BLOCKED_WITH_REASON inside CI. Repaired by the token fix.

config_drift_found_not_fixed.why_not_fixed: data/*.json is verifier-freeze class. The SLO targets in data/autorun-workflows-v1.json were already re-pinned to the real cadence (PR #111); this manifest was not. Founder-gated correction.
